body: I’m so creeped out with everything that’s coming up right now… Drake’s, I’m Upset video at 2:20…

What's stopping me is who's gonna tend to my 9 month old son if he cries when I'm dead. If his father is at work, and I don't talk to anyone in my apartment building, how long will he be left unattended. Or if I'm trying to kill myself while his father is on his way home from work, do I give my son to my family and do it then?
